why_ai: No plant to maintain and an officer certifies only the regulatory filings, but people and businesses will keep paying someone for a phone line in 2031, even as AI-native platforms and the hosts' own brands squeeze resale.
why_clarity: A line works or it doesn't, provisioning and filings follow codified rules, and the same order, port and invoice recur by the million.
why_digital: Numbers, call records and orders in, a service delivered over networks, sold mostly remotely with some local agents and handset shipping.

why_ai: Consumer mobile resale is commodity screen work with no licence or relationship, though demand for mobile service itself is untouched by AI.
why_clarity: Activation, billing and churn are measured exactly across millions of near-identical lines.
why_digital: Sign-up, care and billing are online; only devices and SIMs ship physically.

why_ai: Offload steering and attribution are software problems, while the bundle relationship and owned gateways give the operator some durability.
why_clarity: Wholesale gigabytes per line are measured objectively, but how to steer traffic without hurting experience is still worked out case by case.
why_digital: Gateway and usage telemetry in, service delivered over owned Wi-Fi and a host network, sold to households where the operator's wires reach.

why_ai: App-only resale with no network, licence or relationship is directly exposed to cheaper AI-run flanker brands.
why_clarity: Port-out and payback are exact, recurring outcomes measured on every cohort.
why_digital: Bought, activated, served and left entirely online through eSIM.

why_ai: Local reseller relationships help, but AI-native communications platforms and AI receptionists threaten the seat itself.
why_clarity: Cut-overs and call flows are checkable on the day, repeated across thousands of near-identical small offices.
why_digital: Configured and delivered online, with some local resellers and handset installs.

why_ai: Document matching against carrier records is mechanical and the first thing automation will absorb.
why_clarity: A port is accepted or rejected, on codified rules, hundreds of times a month, with the answer back in days.
why_digital: Documents and carrier portals in, a moved number out, done entirely on screens.

why_ai: Site surveys and device installs on life-safety lines need people on site, and copper retirement keeps the work coming through 2030.
why_clarity: A replaced line passes its device test or not, but discovering what each line serves is still done by walking the site.
why_digital: Physical lines and devices on site, a working physical connection delivered, sold under multi-site contracts often managed remotely.

why_ai: Eligibility checks automate, but reaching subscribers through community enrolment and officers certifying claims keep a human layer, as long as the subsidy lasts.
why_clarity: Eligibility, recertification and usage rules are codified and recur annually per subscriber, though wrongful de-enrolment is rarely measured.
why_digital: Eligibility documents and databases in, mobile service out, with enrolment still often done face to face by agents.

why_ai: The clerk's recommendation at a cash counter is a relationship software can't replace, though the service itself is commodity.
why_clarity: Refills recur monthly in huge volume, but which retailer and route choices keep subscribers is judged by feel.
why_digital: Cash at a local counter in, mobile service out, bought face to face in the neighbourhood.

why_ai: Evidence assembly automates, but officers certify filings personally and adversarial robocallers keep the judgement novel.
why_clarity: Codified FCC filings and traceback responses recur on hard clocks, though whether a customer was truly bad is often never confirmed.
why_digital: Call records, documents and filings in and out, entirely on screens and regulator portals.

why_ai: Rule-bound classification and filing are automatable; an officer still certifies the Form 499.
why_clarity: Tax law and 499 instructions define a correct return, filed on the same schedule every quarter.
why_digital: Billing data in, returns and invoices out, done entirely on screens.

why_ai: Rule-bound filings are automatable, but small providers rely on specialists who know the regulators and sign off on positions.
why_clarity: Codified FCC and USAC rules, quarterly and annual repetition, and acceptance by USAC as the check.
why_digital: Client revenue data in, filings out, done on screens for clients chosen by relationship.

why_ai: Invoice-to-contract audit is pattern matching that AI tools will absorb.
why_clarity: A billing error is found and credited or not, across thousands of near-identical invoices.
why_digital: Invoices and contracts in, findings and credits out, entirely remote.

why_ai: Fraudsters adapt continuously, and AI-enabled fraud raises demand for specialist detection.
why_clarity: Millions of calls are scored the same way, but confirmed-fraud labels are sparse and late.
why_digital: Call records in and alerts out, delivered remotely as software or a managed service.

why_ai: Price databases built partly from public quotes face substitution by AI-compiled pricing.
why_clarity: Price points recur on a fixed update cycle and are checked against transacted quotes.
why_digital: Quotes in, databases and reports sold online worldwide.

why_ai: Licensed counsel and named experts act personally in adversarial, high-stakes proceedings.
why_clarity: Each case is partly bespoke and its outcome arrives months or years later.
why_digital: Call records and filings in, briefs and testimony out, partly delivered in person in hearings and depositions.

why_ai: Already software, and AI voice scams raise demand for call scoring rather than replacing it.
why_clarity: Billions of calls are scored identically, but mislabels surface only when callers complain.
why_digital: Signalling and reports in, labels out in real time through carrier integrations.

why_ai: Market sizing from vendor disclosures is substitutable by AI analysis, though named analysts carry some trust.
why_clarity: Trackers recur quarterly, but forecasts and rankings rest on analyst judgement and are rarely graded.
why_digital: Briefings and surveys in, reports sold online.

why_ai: Credit scoring is automated already; FCRA obligations and the pooled member base keep the exchange durable.
why_clarity: Reports follow codified rules and recur at every application, though default outcomes arrive months later.
why_digital: Member data in, reports out through system integrations.

why_ai: Audit and eligibility checks automate, but a public mandate and accountable officials keep the function.
why_clarity: Codified program rules applied on fixed cycles, though audit outcomes take months.
why_digital: Filings and enrolment records in, decisions and audits out, mostly on screens.

why_ai: Registry operations are routine and automated; the FCC mandate keeps the function itself in place.
why_clarity: Every port and assignment is a codified transaction with an immediate pass or fail.
why_digital: Registry transactions in and out, entirely electronic under FCC contracts.

why_ai: Bespoke strategy and diligence rely on trusted partners and novel judgement, though AI compresses the analysis.
why_clarity: Each engagement is largely one-off and its advice is judged by outcomes years later.
why_digital: Client data in, reports out, sold through partner relationships and some in-person work.

why_ai: Legal authority to remove, fine and prosecute can't be delegated to software, and robocall enforcement demand is rising.
why_clarity: Investigations follow procedure but each case differs, and outcomes take months.
why_digital: Traceback and call records in, orders and cases out, with hearings in person.

why_ai: The portal automates tracing, while its designated status and enforcement link keep it in place.
why_clarity: Each traceback follows the same hop-by-hop procedure with a response due in 24 hours.
why_digital: Requests and responses through an online portal.

why_ai: Deal judgement and seller relationships resist automation, though target screening is automatable.
why_clarity: Each acquisition is one-off and its success is known years later.
why_digital: Data rooms in, models out, with negotiation partly in person.

why_ai: Platform reporting is standard software that AI-native BSS will absorb.
why_clarity: Monthly reports on the same metrics recur for every brand.
why_digital: Platform data in, dashboards out online.
